name: Torrid-Tombolo
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in towering mountain ranges. Travelers navigate by tectonic rift valleys and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Instruments disagree about temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
